valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.peRouteNote: the two P/E routes differ (market cap over net profit 412.68, price over EPS 164.29); the net-profit row reconciles with the filing's own profit before tax less tax, so the EPS row is the one filed in a different unit
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (ajwaforfoodindustriesco) is served under two keys, EGS30211C014 P/E 364.89 and EGS30211C014.CA P/E 336.28, and they disagree; one market capitalisation cannot be two, so neither multiple is verified. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 32.69 percent a year from FY2020 (3.51e+06) to FY2024 (1.088e+07), over 4 years
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2024 divided by the shares on file
valuation.pbFormula: price / (equity per share), equity on FY2024
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2024
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 2.00953e+07 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_EGX.json)
valuation.psFormula: price / (revenue per share), revenue on FY2024

valuation.psSharesSource: the same 2.00953e+07 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_EGX.json)
